questions.prompt: What is the primary tech stack for this role? (e.g. Python/Django, Node.js, Go, React)
Which programming languages are mandatory — not nice to have?
Is cloud experience required? If yes, which provider — AWS, GCP, or Azure?
Will this person be expected to own system design or architecture decisions?
Is microservices or distributed systems experience required?
How large is the engineering team they will join, and how many direct collaborators?
Will this engineer own features end-to-end or contribute within a larger team?
Is on-call rotation expected for this role?
Is open-source contribution or public GitHub activity a positive signal?
Is prior domain experience required — e.g. fintech, healthtech, e-commerce, or is it open?
Will they be expected to mentor junior engineers or lead code reviews?
Does the team prioritise shipping speed or engineering quality and reliability?
Is this a B2B or B2C role? What is the primary sales motion — inbound, outbound, or both?
What is the typical sales cycle length — days, weeks, or months?
What is the expected monthly or quarterly quota for this person?
Is there a specific territory, region, or vertical they will own?

What is the average deal size — SMB, mid-market, or enterprise?
Which CRM or sales tools must they have used — Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, Apollo?
Should they bring an existing book of business or client relationships?

Is this primarily a UX, UI, product design, or brand/visual design role?
Which design tools are mandatory — Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, Principle?

Is a portfolio of shipped product work required? Any specific domain — mobile, web, SaaS?
Is the product early-stage and ambiguous, or are they joining a mature, well-defined product?

Is motion design or animation experience a nice-to-have or required?

Will this PM own full product discovery and research, or focus on delivery and execution?
What type of metrics ownership is expected — DAU, revenue, activation, retention?

Is prior domain experience required — fintech, marketplace, enterprise SaaS, consumer?
Who are the primary stakeholders — C-suite, customers, sales, or engineering leadership?

Is strong data and SQL fluency expected, or is analytics more tool-based (Amplitude, Mixpanel)?
Any required tools — Jira, Linear, Notion, Productboard, Figma collaboration?
What is the expected shipping cadence — weekly releases, monthly, or long-cycle project delivery?
Is this a data science, data engineering, analytics, or ML/AI engineering role?

What is the data stack — Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, dbt, Spark, Databricks?

Who are their primary stakeholders — product, finance, marketing, or engineering?
Is strong business acumen and the ability to translate data into decisions critical?
Is domain-specific data experience required — e.g. financial data, health data, user behaviour?
Is data visualisation tool proficiency required — Tableau, Looker, Power BI, Superset?
Will they own data infrastructure and pipelines or primarily consume existing data?
Is experience running A/B tests and statistical experimentation a strong signal?
How large is the data team today, and is this person an early or later hire?
Which operational domain is this — revenue ops, supply chain, customer ops, business ops, or project delivery?
Which operational tools must they be proficient in — Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira, Asana, NetSuite?
Is experience building processes from scratch required, or optimising existing ones?
How cross-functional is this role — which teams will they work with most closely?
Is data fluency required — SQL, Excel/Sheets, BI tools, or reporting dashboards?
Have they operated in a similar scale environment — headcount, volume, geography?
Is vendor or third-party management experience required?
Is this a highly autonomous role or will they work within a structured management layer?
Who does this person report to and how many direct reports will they have, if any?
What KPIs or OKRs will they be held accountable to in the first 90 days?

Will this person own or administer payroll? If yes, which countries or jurisdictions?

Will this person act as a strategic business partner to senior leadership?
Is experience writing or overhauling HR policies and employee handbooks expected?
Is compensation benchmarking or benefits administration part of this role?
Is prior experience building an HR function from scratch in a startup or scaleup important?
How central is DEI programme ownership to this role?
What are the top three responsibilities this person will own in their first 90 days?
What experience or background is absolutely non-negotiable for this role?
What makes this role hard to fill — niche skills, specific background, or culture fit?
What does the growth path look like for someone who excels in this role?
Who will this person work most closely with day to day?
